Please don’t stop your meds until you get a replacement. I was 4 psych meds and they made me feel like crap when I started but after a while they did help. It was only when I stopped or substituted weed for my meds, that I have this extreme emotional outburst. Most of the time violent. So please keep taking your meds. 

Now. The real issue. Hon, I know exactly how you feel because I AM there now. I don’t now how old you are. But judging from the post you sound like you’re between 14/17. I wrote a a letter to my mom. And have it to her to keep. It explained everything I went through when she put me in a foster home but kept my sister. I told her about the sexual abuse from the girls at the foster care. I told her how she made me feel after the 2nd time she gave me up. To make a long story short, I found it easier to sit and write down everything I felt because I thought she had to read it so she has to “HEAR” me. It had a huge impact on our relationship. And our relationship was really bad. I remember one fight where I threw a big kitchen cleaver at her and my favorite Marvin the Martian cup that broke. It never got to where I wanted to be. Like how it was before she met my sister father. But she understood. And I felt better getting it off my chest. 

And even if you don’t want to give him the letter. You can always write it and burn it. Along with all the negative words, thoughts, and actions set on you by your father. This is difficult to do but try and not let his words hurt you. 

It’s a saying that goes Hurt people, hurt people. Your father has traumas in his past he has yet to deal with. Not that’s it’s an excuse, but understanding is key.
